acceptance: If pursued: no change to PR required checks; peak-hour slot use by scheduled workflows measured before and after.
description:
For consideration, not a required change (owner, 2026-11-19).

Observed (72 h to 2026-11-19): scheduled runs fired 8-9 h late, into the busiest hours: trunk-uat (cron 02:00) started 09:45-10:13 and held up to 9 runner slots for 2-5 h; nightly-v2 (07:30, 47 jobs, no max-parallel) started 16:37-17:12; docker-integration and release-canary started around 16:00-17:50. The hourly review-gate/verdict sweep crons fired only 9 times each in 72 h. Cause of the delay unknown [inference: GitHub-side].

Ideas: max-parallel on nightly-v2 (~11) and trunk-uat (~10, 112, 199, 276); run trunk-coverage less than 7x/day (~14-15); slow or drop the hourly gate/verdict sweeps given they also trigger on push (review-gate.yml ~26, review-verdict.yml ~27).
